ValidationRule.description: This rule shows a error message if the user want use the Close All Topics feature and the Custom Setting is inactive.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( dwp_kitv__account_id__c != null, dwp_kitv__lead_id__c == null, NOT( $Setup.dwp_kitv__TopicValidationsAcc__c.dwp_kitv__ActivateCloseAllTopicsFeature__c ), NOT(PRIORVALUE( dwp_kitv__CloseAllTopics__c )), dwp_kitv__CloseAllTopics__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't use the Close All Topics feature if the Custom Setting isn't active. Please read the documentation for activation this feature.
